verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent, with per-chat model selection and agent-driven worktrees and PR reviews via `gh`. Nothing documents a visual diff viewer or running multiple sessions side by side in the UI. Agent-run `gh` PR reviews and worktree creation are adjacent features, not visual diff review or a parallel-session interface.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
